resources.string: Inspect current and alternative findings
Current and alternative observations
Checking the saved current context and this one alternative using the captured catalog, rules and workload. No partial observations are shown.

These local rule observations compare the saved current context, one alternative, and the same slot left empty. Every rule is retained, including unchanged failures, unknown and skipped outcomes. An outcome change does not establish its cause or measured improvement. Browsing changes no draft or choice.

Free text objectives remain outside these checks. Evidence applicability, cost, resources, measured quality and runtime readiness are not established. Return to the choice picker to make a separate explicit selection.
